name: Visco Vision Inc.
summary: Visco Vision, Inc. engages in the production and sale of disposable soft contact lenses, It specializes in design and production of disposable contact lenses with different water content and oxygen permeability According to the same use cycle, it can be divided into daily, weekly, bi-weekly and monthly throws. The company offers general myopia correction, astigmatism, multifocal, anti-blue lens, and makeup lens that can change the color of the iris. Visco Vision was founded on November 9, 1998 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.
